overview: Surah An-Nas (Mankind) is the 114th and final chapter of the Holy Quran, consisting of 6 verses in Juz 30. Paired with Surah Al-Falaq (113) as Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, it completes the Quran with a direct appeal for spiritual protection.

While Surah Al-Falaq seeks refuge from external harms using one divine attribute (Lord of the daybreak), Surah An-Nas invokes three comprehensive attributes of Allah—Lord of mankind (Rabb), Sovereign of mankind (Malik), and God of mankind (Ilah)—to seek protection from one deeply internal threat: the retreating whisperer (al-waswas al-khannas) who whispers doubts and temptation into human hearts, whether from among jinn or people.

The surah reminds believers that spiritual whispering retreats when a person remembers Allah. Recited regularly before sleep, in daily prayers, and in morning and evening adhkar, Surah An-Nas anchors the heart in reliance on its Creator.
mainThemes: Invoking Allah's lordship (Rabb), sovereignty (Malik), and sole right to worship (Ilah).
Seeking protection from internal whispering (waswasah) and spiritual temptation.
Recognizing that whispering retreats through remembrance of Allah.

virtues.text: The Prophet ﷺ described Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas as unmatched verses for seeking refuge in Allah.
Every night before sleeping, the Prophet ﷺ recited Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas into his hands and wiped over his body three times.

faqs.question: How many verses are in Surah An-Nas?
faqs.answer: Surah An-Nas has 6 verses (ayahs) and is the 114th and final chapter of the Holy Quran.

faqs.question: How does Surah An-Nas differ from Surah Al-Falaq?
faqs.answer: Surah Al-Falaq seeks refuge primarily from external harms (darkness, sorcery, envy), while Surah An-Nas seeks refuge from internal whispering (waswasah) into human hearts.

faqs.question: When is Surah An-Nas traditionally recited?
faqs.answer: It is commonly recited alongside Surah Al-Ikhlas and Surah Al-Falaq before sleeping (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017), in daily prayers, and in morning and evening remembrances.

relatedSurahs.reason: Surah Al-Falaq pairs with An-Nas as Al-Mu'awwidhatayn.
Surah Al-Ikhlas is recited with Al-Falaq and An-Nas before sleep.
Surah Al-Fatihah opens the Quran with guidance; An-Nas closes it with protection.
